R-accessibility-1 (Field errors are conveyed by a red border only, with no text) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
`field--invalid`, a red border (`#e5484d`); the list of errors at the top of
the page is removed, since the red border already shows where the problem
is. No message text is added, to keep the form compact.
findings.recommendation: Screen reader users and colour-blind users cannot tell that a field is invalid nor why: a customer who tabs out of the postcode field with `ABC` hears nothing, and the only signal left once the top error list is removed is a border colour (WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color, 3.3.1 Error Identification, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value). Show a short text message under each invalid field (or next to it), link it with `aria-describedby`, set `aria-invalid="true"` on the input, and do not rely on colour alone (add an icon or the text). Update the spec scenarios in `specs/checkout-validation/spec.md` ("An invalid postcode" / "A corrected field"), which today only check that the border turns red and back to grey, so the tests in task 1.2 require the message and its association, and drop the "invalid fields are shown in red" wording from the proposal's What Changes.
findings.title: Field errors are conveyed by a red border only, with no text

findings.evidence:
the list of errors at the top of
the page is removed
findings.recommendation: The design describes validation on `blur` only and says nothing about what happens when the form is submitted with invalid or untouched fields. With the error summary gone, a keyboard or screen reader user who presses Enter on the submit button gets no announcement and no focus change, and an invalid field may be off-screen (WCAG 3.3.1 Error Identification, 2.4.3 Focus Order, 4.1.3 Status Messages). State the submit behaviour in the design: validate every field on submit and move focus to the first invalid field, or keep an error summary that receives focus and links to each field.
findings.title: Nothing tells the customer about errors on submit once the top error list is removed
